g.text: module: total latent dims = num_patches × proj_dim – matched across the two features
the confound – one factor changed the FEATURE and the CAPACITY together
num_patches = ( img_size / patch_size )² , img_size = 224 , proj_dim = 384 on both sides
so BOTH of round 7's readings are confounded
n = 12 – a NULL: the interval spans zero
each ROW is a cls-vs-patch contrast at the SAME total latent dims
16 finished seeds · the baseline of ~120 contrasts
8 new seeds · patch tokens, without the capacity
8 new seeds · width, without the tokens
8 new seeds · width, without the tokens
each COLUMN is a capacity ladder at the SAME feature – × 4 , × 4 , × 16
proj_dim is set independently of the ViT width
the arm name carries proj_dim, so collect_evals cannot pool two architectures
